## Gate A: it works as intended

- [ ] Verification report attached (`npm run verify`, verify-report/index.html)
- [ ] Cards for this change written before building it, and passing (A1, A2)
- [ ] Direction rows added or still passing (A3)
- [ ] Importers: round trip within the stated margin (A4)
- [ ] New anatomy: containment passes and four-angle shots look right (A5)
- [ ] Five-second test done by someone who did not build it (A6)

## Gate B: it serves the goal

1. Which measured input does it use, or which inside-the-body question does it answer?
2. Can a non-medical person understand it without the docs?
3. Where does it show on the body or brain?
4. Does it change visibly when its input changes? (rest/change pair)
5. Does it duplicate anything already on screen?
6. What does it cost? (lines, MB downloaded, controls on screen)
